Given: P + Q − R $ S % T

P + Q → P is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4549161b1123d5129c510127a4a4ac3f2e9967e25aa02c3c76d554def455b39b.png] 

Q − R → Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f20e8ed69cd471bf77b6b5a4cfc3ea012bbec177f07012b0c2034af38213fb7f.png] 

R $ S → R is the daughter of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05cbec2226a56787d7daf79f95c5d0b150d3406d5995ab258824fda28cd3ac8d.png] 

S % T → S is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c641b9540fd1d3a99612f677d42086c00028087e221fd7296146f527966bea34.png] 

Thus, P is S's husband’s mother or mother-in-law.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
